newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea Int'l Merchant Bank sets bonus, rights issues.
newsitem.headline: Korea Int'l Merchant Bank sets bonus, rights issues.

text.p: Korea International Merchant Bank said on Monday it plans to offer a 38-for-100 rights issue and an 11-for-100 bonus issue, both in March.
The bank's paid-in capital would rise to 48.64 billion won from the current 29.64 billion, the bank said in a statement.

The bank plans a rights issue of 2.8 million common shares, of which 20 percent would be offered to its employees. The rest will be offered to shareholders registered as of January 30 for rights, the statement said.
The rights issue price will be set at a 20 percent discount to the base price, which will be decided later.
Subscription is scheduled for March 3 and 4, with payment due by March 6.
